execution_closure.interpretation: Analysis-only dependency accounting; never fabricates an execution observation, elapsed time, or task success for an unstarted cell. Does not establish semantic acceptance.

limitations: Post hoc pure predicate rechecks explain specific saved failures; they do not change scores or establish semantic correctness.
A failed proposal may have more errors after the first rejection; do not infer exhaustive diagnosis.
Snapshot totals may grow while the approved batch runs; unstarted cells remain in the denominator.
Advertised-rate bounds assume the public CNY rates apply; account currency, discounts and actual charges are not verified.
